name: Post Metric Scholarship For OBC Students
benefit: The benefit of the scholarship depends on the annual family income of the students, institution, course, course subscriber, fee capping, etc. All students whose annual family income is up to Rs 3,00,000, those students will be eligible for a 100% scholarship.
eligibility_rules: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. Annual family income is up to Rs 3,00,000/-Have passed Class
documents_required: Samagra ID.Current college code. Income certificate of parents. Aadhaar Card. High School
Marksheet. Digital Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC).Attested photocopies of documents. Resident proof.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Applicants have to visit the official website. Applicants need to register himself/herself. Fill out the required details. Now login with credentials and fill out the application form. And submit.
